score_end: latest completed native M30 in extraction
measured_execution_costs: unavailable; bar spread field is descriptive, not actual entry/exit spread
sessions: historical mapping unverified; unassigned primary; conditional fixed UTC+2 and New-York-DST UTC+2/3 scenarios only
session_windows: Asia Tokyo 09-18; London 08-17; New York 08-17 local; end exclusive; decision-time membership; exclusive joined memberships
holdout: unchanged first GBPUSD baseline; no parameter fitting; later diagnostics expose all periods and are exploratory
nonoverlap: entry index strictly greater than prior accepted signal index plus 12; no queuing
drawdown: realized cumulative pip changes, one serial event at a time, no sizing or mark-to-market; reported on nonoverlap sensitivity only
warmup_check: 250 bars prior to 2026 with recursive seeds versus full 2025 history
gate_ablation: one component removed per variant; retain episode lifecycle, one signal total, entry and horizon contract; report added and displaced baseline signals
